name: Entur Live Transit
description: Provider integration for Entur realtime vehicles and Journey Planner situations in Norway

dataSources.purpose: Poll live positions of monitored Norwegian transit vehicles within the visible map area to animate them on the live-transit overlay
dataSources.dataSent: A GraphQL query containing the map bounding-box coordinates, a maximum data-age window, and the ET-Client-Name header; no user data
dataSources.dataReceived: Realtime vehicle positions with coordinates, bearing, speed, transport mode, line, operator, and service-journey references

dataSources.purpose: Fetch nationwide service alerts and disruption messages from the Journey Planner and show those affecting the visible map area
dataSources.dataSent: A GraphQL query for all national situations plus the ET-Client-Name header; no user data or location is sent (bounding-box filtering happens server-side after the fetch)
dataSources.dataReceived: Service situations with localized summaries and descriptions, severity, report type, validity periods, and the affected lines, stop places, and quays
